videos.title: UX Design Critiques: 3 Tips for Effective Feedback
videos.why: Three habits for giving feedback with confidence, which are trusting that your view is useful, structuring what you say, and balancing strengths with problems.

videos.title: Live design critique with the Figma design team - Noah Levin, Sara Culver, Kelly Li (Config 2021)
videos.why: Watch a real product team critique one of its own features, from the quiet review time to the group discussion, so you can copy the format.

podcasts.episode: Remember the Four Questions of Critique (feat. Adam Connor)
podcasts.why: The co-author of Discussing Design on good critique practice and the four questions at the heart of his approach.

podcasts.episode: Christophe Tauziet - Plaid’s culture of craft, tips for CRIT, and lessons from early Facebook
podcasts.why: Plaid's head of design on running useful critiques, holding polish reviews and giving better design feedback.

reads.title: Design Critiques: Encourage a Positive Culture to Improve Products
reads.why: How to set up and run a critique, with clear roles for presenter and reviewers and feedback that stays tied to the design's goals.

reads.title: How we do design critiques at Figma
reads.why: Several critique formats a real team uses for different stages of work, which you can adapt even when your only reviewer is an AI tool.

reads.title: How to Give and Receive Criticism
reads.why: A classic essay on asking for the feedback you actually need and hearing hard criticism without getting defensive.
